Supreme Court Strikes Down Maharashtra Methanol Additive Rules

The Supreme Court has struck down Maharashtra government rules that mandated the addition of specific substances to methanol. The court ruled that these rules were arbitrary and lacked scientific basis. It also noted that such regulations could lead to unintended consequences, including the promotion of illicit liquor trade. The bench issued directions to the state government regarding the regulation of methanol. The specific substances mandated as additives and the exact directions issued by the court were not detailed in the coverage.
